entries.title: Cone Volcano With Rising Magma Column
entries.description: A 3D conical volcano sits on a light-colored terrain while a red semi-transparent magma column rises inside a hollow shaft, pressurizes, then bursts through the crater as glowing particle jets and lava blobs that roll down the slopes, cool, and darken.

entries.title: Lava Fountain and Lava Flow Rivers
entries.description: A central vent emits pulsing lava fountains made of small spheres that arc upward and fall, merging into branching lava rivers that flow downhill around stationary rocks, slowly building layered crusts that thicken, darken, and crack.

entries.title: Explosive Stratovolcano With Ash Plume
entries.description: A tall stratovolcano cone violently ejects fragmented rock particles and ash as gray and black particle clouds that rise, expand, and drift downwind, with denser ash falling to create layered deposits and lighter ash forming a spreading umbrella-shaped plume.

entries.title: Submarine Volcano and Bubble Plumes
entries.description: A volcanic mound on a seabed releases hot glowing lava that creeps along the ocean floor while chains of transparent bubbles rise, expand, and burst at the water surface, with temperature-colored water parcels circulating and mixing around the vent.

entries.title: Volcanic Bomb Trajectories and Impacts
entries.description: Large glowing volcanic bombs are launched from a vent with varying initial velocities, follow arcing trajectories, leave faint trails, and impact the ground with bouncing, fracturing, and embedding behaviors that form craters and scatter fragments.

entries.description: Dense, fast-moving pyroclastic flows made of hot particle clouds detach from the eruptive column, hug the terrain, wrap around hills, overtop ridges, and mark their paths with ash and pumice deposits that accumulate and slowly cool.
